Desert plant adaptations discussed with the user: cacti store water in fleshy stems; Joshua trees and yuccas have deep roots and thick leaves; creosote bush has extensive roots and small waxy leaves to limit water loss. #desert_adaptations #plants

Discussed that humans have no biological adaptation to arid climates, only cultural and technological ones: irrigation, wells/rainwater capture, desalination, water recycling, and drought-tolerant crops. #water_scarcity #human_adaptation

User asked about environmental downsides of water-scarcity technology. Desalination: high energy use and greenhouse gases, brine/chemical discharge harming marine life. Lower-impact alternatives to desalination discussed: water conservation (leak repair, low-flow fixtures), rainwater harvesting, green infrastructure (permeable pavement, green roofs, rain gardens), ecosystem restoration of wetlands/riparian areas, and treated wastewater reuse. #water_scarcity #sustainability
